title: Jolly German Quinoa Bake
description: A comforting German dish featuring quinoa, perfect for a sick day, with a bitter and pillowy texture. This nut-free-friendly bake is a great option for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, bring the quinoa and water to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
In a large skillet, saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the caraway seeds, bitter kale, salt, and pepper to the skillet and cook until the kale is wilted.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked quinoa, skillet mixture, and german beer.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with swiss cheese.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
